title: Grateful Dead Live at Manor Downs on 1982-07-31
lineage: modified Nak CM-700's > Sony TC-D5M > Nak Dragon > HHB CDR 800 > CDR > Samsung SW-232B > EAC v0.9 beta 4 > CD Wave > shntool > SHN

ai_review.summary: Clean audience tape captures a high‑energy 1982 show with a smoking Scarlet → Fire, a joyous Jerry birthday moment and tight second‑set playing.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) source that most listeners describe as clear, crisp and surprisingly balanced, though a few note it’s a bit Phil‑lite. Musically the concert shines – the second set is highlighted by a blazing Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain, a heartfelt Morning Dew birthday shout for Jerry, and an inspired Truckin' intro jam, all delivered with tight, high‑energy playing.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average ~4.25) and overwhelmingly positive comments about both performance and sound quality; only minor recording quibbles noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape with clean, crisp audio; some listeners mention a slightly thin bass (Phil‑lite) but overall balanced and listenable.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set dominates with tight playing and seamless transitions; overall setlist praised as perfect and tightly arranged.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for “going to town,” great tone, and birthday shout that energized the crowd.
band_member_comments.Phil: A few note it’s a bit Phil‑lite (bass slightly thin) compared to expectations.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent and Bobby on keyboards are highlighted as working well together.
